expectations: no operator passkey on the Users screen
context: area: src/Umbral/Infrastructure (AdminAuth.fs, WebAuthn.fs, Passkeys.fs ceremonies, Database.fs schema 7)
constraint: constitution 3.0.1 Principle VII operator credential bullet
constraint: reuse WebAuthn.Verifier, do not copy
intent: Operator passkeys for the admin area and a switch to turn password sign-in off

decisions.decision: Verifier takes keys and a uniqueness function instead of user Passkey records
decisions.why: reuse the one WebAuthn module for both kinds

decisions.decision: Operator ceremonies share passkey_ceremonies with three operator purposes
decisions.why: single-use, expiry and lifetime already tested

decisions.decision: Re-check carried by each action request (password or a confirm ceremony answer)
decisions.why: no elevated window to steal, same as replacing the password

decisions.decision: AdminAuth.verify refuses every password while the switch is off
Admin limit on checking/completing requests, connector ceremony limit on options
decisions.why: options check nothing; admin limit would halve passkey sign-ins

decisions.decision: Remove and switch-off rotate the session stamp
decisions.why: usual reason is a lost device or a doubted password

plan.summary: Plan: schema 8 table, shared verifier/ceremonies, new operator handler module, verify refuses while off
plan.key_finding: WebAuthn.Verifier is coupled to Passkeys.Passkey in three members; decoupling them is the reuse point

tasks.summary: 24 tasks: foundational 8 (schema, store, verifier, AdminAuth, texts), US1 5, US2 2, US3 2, US4 2, polish 5

approach: A new operator_passkeys table (schema 8) and two settings rows. The connector's WebAuthn verifier and ceremony store are reused with operator purposes. New Admin/OperatorPasskeys.fs handles the ceremonies, remove and the switch; AdminAuth.verify refuses passwords while off.
